messages:
mike: Kicking off late-shift rollout for v2026.3 — plan US -> EU -> APAC. Window starts 00:30 PT. Canary then progressive ramp. Ping infra for capacity checks + oncall handoff. Deploy bot will kick the canary at 00:30.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy v2026.3 to service=model-serving. Canary slice=5% at 2026-03-21T00:30:00-07:00. Auto-checks: cpu>80% || error-rate>1.2% over 5m -> rollback hook.
sarah: oncall for EU/APAC handoff, I'm available until 08:00 UTC. I'll watch latency and error dashboards.
lee: Running final capacity sweep now. Reserving ~30% cushion on us-east and eu-west. APAC will have a 20% cushion until warm pools finish warmup.
kai: Pinned runtime=4.2.1 on canary nodes. If perf regressions appear we can pin back to 4.1.8 quickly.
mike: Quick checklist: who owns the rollback decision for canary? and what's the exact rollback command for ops?
deploy-bot: Rollback command (ops):

```
/deploy rollback --service model-serving --to v2026.2 --reason "<short_reason>"
```

Note: this will stop all canary traffic and restore previous routing.
maria: Release notes draft is in release/2026.3 but hold public announce until EU gate is green. Messaging team on standby.
lee: Smoke test plan posted to deck: 1) 5m latency p50/p95 check; 2) throughput tokens/s; 3) error budget sanity. Dash link: https://dash.redwood/internal/deploys/2165432101
ops-bot: Warm pool pre-warm triggered for us-east-1 — +8 gpus allocated, warmup ETA ~6m.
sarah: Reminder: APAC handoff scheduled 05:30 UTC. @kai can you cover 05:30-07:00 UTC to watch KV cache and tail logs?
kai: yes, I'll be on 05:30-07:00 UTC. I'll watch KV cache fill and tail the rt logs.
mike: If we hit rollback, immediately notify #eng-oncall, run the rollback command above, then pin previous model version to 100% traffic to avoid partial routing.
lee: Autoscaler note: min replicas set to 3 for canary pods, and burst window extended by +30s to avoid thrash during ramp.
mike: OK starting canary in 5m. Everyone stand by :eyes:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary=5% -> running health checks. log id=deploy-2165432101-canary
sarah: Monitoring now. If latency or errors spike I'll cut to 0% and request rollback.
mike: Thanks — will post EU gate result in ~20m. Folx on late shift, please keep pings to critical only. :thumbsup:
